verdict.rationale: Autumn documents plans defined in code, an attach endpoint that handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades, recurring billing periods, multi-phase subscription schedules, and a preview endpoint showing what customers will be charged before a subscription change. Trials and proration are not explicitly documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documented free-trial support, explicit proration behavior on upgrades and downgrades, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Attaches a plan to a customer. Handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades.
The `atmn` CLI lets you define your pricing plans in code via an `autumn.config.ts` file, and sync them to Autumn with a single command.
